name: Cannes-Mandelieu Airport

hours.v: air traffic control open from 08:00 local; closing 20:00 in winter, 21:00 in spring and autumn, 22:00 from early May to late August (FBO opens 06:30)
hours.quote: FBO and ATC closing hours (local time)

max_aircraft.v: jets up to 35 tonnes and turboprops up to 22 tonnes
max_aircraft.quote: Limit on 35 t turbojet / 22 t turboprop aircraft

noise.v: noisier aircraft (margin under 13 EPNdB, ICAO chapter 3) are banned; APU use limited to 20 minutes before and 10 minutes after flight
noise.quote: Ban on noisier aircraft (<13 EPNdB ICAO chapter 3)

slots.v: listed by the French coordinator as Level 3; business and general aviation slots are requested through the handling agent
slots.quote: General and business aviation operators ask their handling agent Skyvallet to request slots

handling.v: handling agent named by the coordinator: Skyvallet

notes: French eAIP and Légifrance (arrêté of 6 Dec 1995 as amended, latest 26 Nov 2025) could not be opened. Hours conflict: the COHOR page says opening is 'from 08:00 local time until 30 mns after sunset' while the operator's airport page gives a fixed seasonal closing table (20:00/21:00/22:00); the year the table applies to is not shown. The COHOR Level 3 text refers to 16 May-17 Sep 2023, so the current coordination status should be confirmed; specific procedures apply during the Monaco Grand Prix and Cannes Film Festival. City set to Nice per the task grouping; the airport serves Cannes.
